reviews.text: I went to Dr. Germani today for the first time because my dog ​​was terribly ill. In addition to his helpfulness and kindness, he was extremely professional. For anyone who has pets, trust in a vet is the foundation of everything, and the doctor immediately gave me the impression of great competence. I won't tell you the story, but suffice it to say that my Maltese had been dazed for three days, and his vet said it "could be muscle pain!!!" In reality, it was something much more trivial, but if left untreated, it could have had extremely serious consequences. A thorough examination, dietary advice, and then... during the walk home, the dog freed himself from the intestinal blockage and came back even more mischievous than before. Thanks again to Dr. Germani for his patience, his availability, and for giving me my furry friend back to health. ♥ I don't recommend him: I HIGHLY RECOMMEND HIM ♥♥♥

Good morning, Dr. Germani has been my cat's vet for several years. He is very knowledgeable in his field, very patient (which is extremely rare these days), and he connects with animals (my cat loves him and is afraid of him)...but above all, he is very patient with the parents of their furry friends too!!! I recommend him 🐶🐱🐭🐰🐕🐩🐈‍⬛🐈🐿️🦔

He's been my trusted vet for years. He's empathetic and very helpful. My dogs (two Maltese) love him very much. He's always treated them with great professionalism and expertise. Five stars isn't enough.

Dr. Germani is a wonderful vet. I took my Mirtillo to be spayed after a thousand fears, and I couldn't have made a better choice.
He's always available for everything. If you're looking for a trustworthy vet, I highly recommend him.
Terrible service, he never knew how to solve a problem with my dog, I had to go to a private doctor and he always acted rudely.

It's truly incomprehensible how this person has good reviews. This "doctor," of dubious competence, failed to diagnose my dog's heart disease, claiming she was overweight and lazy. He prescribed her a weight-loss kibble, which he claimed was miraculous for obese people, but it had no effect whatsoever. My dog ​​died three months later, suffering a heart attack during a walk. Be careful with your pets; this person is neither humane nor competent. I'm telling you honestly, please seek someone else's advice. He didn't even verify the dog's death or even apologize. A terrible person; he'll have our Molly on his conscience for the rest of his life.

Dr. Germani is undoubtedly a top-notch doctor. He's been treating our little Leyla for a year now, and I can say we're extremely satisfied. Our dog is so pampered that she's always happy every time we visit. I recommend him to both beginners and experienced practitioners. Professionalism and empathy.

Dr. Germani has been treating my 13-year-old dog, Raia, since 2017.
He's very helpful and thorough in taking care of the animals he needs to see, and he's friendly with their owners.
He's excellent at his job and you can tell he loves animals. Honest and always available. I recommend him to everyone!
I'd like to thank Dr. Germani again for always being available and competent. He cared for Yaki as long as he could. He was truly a humane and caring person.

Excellent, both Dr. Germani and the doctor.
My dog ​​has been to other vet clinics. He used to get very nervous, but here he's calm. Second credit goes to the doctor because he feels safe.
Plus, they're very honest.

Veterinarian Germani is a kind, thorough, reliable, and professional person.
Highly recommended.
